prose: Bloomberg reports DeepSeek has released a 'creator mode' for DeepSeek Harness, letting users build custom plugins such as a 3D model renderer and a video editing workbench. The open-weights lab is moving up the stack from models to an extensible agent platform - the same plugin ecosystem play the US labs have been building, from the company that keeps undercutting them on price.
highlights: DeepSeek 'creator mode' lets users build custom Harness plugins (3D renderer, video workbench)
The open-weights lab is moving from models to platform, matching US labs' ecosystem strategy
